# CANDIDATE: VIX_MEANREV_VWAP_DEVIATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extreme intraday VIX deviations coupled with SPY price extended from VWAP predict a mean‑reversion move in both. When VIX spikes above its 20‑period 5‑min mean while SPY trades above VWAP, a short‑term mean reversion in VIX and SPY price is likely. The inverse holds for low VIX and SPY below VWAP. This exploits temporary dislocation between volatility expectations and price action.

## Mechanism

Calculate 20‑period mean and standard deviation of VIX on 5‑min bars.  
Entry short: VIX > mean + 1×σ AND SPY close > VWAP + 0.5% → enter short at bar close.  
Entry long: VIX < mean − 1×σ AND SPY close < VWAP − 0.5% → enter long at bar close.  
Exit: Initial stop at 0.5% adverse move from entry price. TP1 at 1R (same distance as stop). Runner trail: trail stop at 15% of profit from high‑water mark (for longs) or low‑water mark (for shorts).  
Regime filter: Only trade between 10:00‑15:00 ET, avoid first/last 30 minutes. Require intraday VIX >12 to ensure sufficient volatility for mean reversion.
